# File drop: `jl-file-drop`

A zone to drop files on or browse for them, with the chosen files listed under it.

- Class `JlFileDrop`, a molecule: `import { JlFileDrop } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/file-drop

A zone to drop files on, with a Browse button for those who would rather pick them. It turns blue while
files are dragged over it. The files it takes are listed under it, with their size and a button to take each one
back; the ones it refuses (not of an accepted type, larger than max-size, one too many) are listed with the reason.

Without multiple, a new file replaces the one there. In a form, the files are entries under the field's name, as
from a native file input, so a multipart submission sends them. Read them with the files property.

## Use

```ts
import { JlFileDrop } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlFileDrop accept="image/*,.pdf" maxSize={10485760} multiple />
```

```html
<jl-file-drop accept="image/*,.pdf" max-size="10485760" multiple></jl-file-drop>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `files` (property only): `File[]`, default `[]`. The files it holds, in the order they came (read only).
- `accept` (attribute `accept`): `string`, default `''`. The types it takes, as a file input’s accept: extensions, MIME types, families such as image/*.
- `multiple` (attribute `multiple`): `boolean`, default `false`. Takes several files; otherwise a new one replaces the file there.
- `maxSize` (attribute `max-size`): `number`, default `0`. The largest file it takes, in bytes; 0 for no limit.
- `text` (attribute `text`): `string`, default `''`. The text in the zone; by default "Drop a file here" (or files).
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. How roomy the zone is.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data: each file is an entry under it.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The accessible name of the zone, when its text is not enough.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted without a file.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Takes no file; the chosen ones stay listed.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. The zone drawn in the danger colour, for an error the page found.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `File[]`: Files were added or taken back: the whole list.

## Methods

- `browse(): void`: Opens the file chooser.
- `add(files: File[]): void`: Takes files as a drop would, such as files dropped elsewhere on the page: those it accepts fire change, the others say why not.
- `clear(): void`: Takes every file back and empties the list of refused ones; fires nothing.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the Browse button.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether a required field has a file.
- `reportValidity(): boolean`: The same check; when it fails, the browser shows its message on the control.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The drop zone.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Several images

Images up to 2 MB, several at once. Drop a text file or a large photo to see it refused.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-file-drop label="Screenshots" accept="image/*" max-size="2097152" multiple></jl-file-drop>
</div>
```

### A single file

One PDF, with a text of its own; a second file replaces the first.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-file-drop accept=".pdf" max-size="10485760" text="Drop your CV here"></jl-file-drop>
</div>
```

### Compact, and listening

The paragraph lists what change gives; the button empties the field with clear().

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-file-drop class="demo-files" size="sm" multiple text="Attachments"></jl-file-drop>
  <div class="row">
    <jl-button class="demo-clear" size="sm" icon="trash" label="Remove all"></jl-button>
    <span class="muted demo-files-out">No attachment.</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
const drop = root.querySelector('.demo-files');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-files-out');
drop.events.register('change', (files) => {
  const total = files.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.size, 0);
  out.textContent = `${files.length} file(s), ${total} bytes.`;
});
root.querySelector('.demo-clear').events.register('press', () => {
  drop.clear();
  out.textContent = 'No attachment.';
});
```

### In a form

The form data holds the files under the name "photos".

```html
<form class="stack narrow demo-upload">
  <jl-file-drop name="photos" accept="image/*" multiple required></jl-file-drop>
  <div class="row">
    <jl-button type="submit" variant="primary" icon="upload" label="Upload"></jl-button>
  </div>
  <p class="muted demo-upload-out">Choose images, then upload.</p>
</form>
```

```js
const form = root.querySelector('.demo-upload');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-upload-out');
form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const names = new FormData(form).getAll('photos').map((file) => file.name);
  out.textContent = `Would upload: ${names.join(', ')}`;
});
```

### States

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-file-drop disabled text="Uploads are paused"></jl-file-drop>
  <jl-file-drop invalid size="sm" text="A file is required"></jl-file-drop>
</div>
```
